title: build(deps): bump zod from 4.5.4 to 4.6.2
intent: Routine Dependabot currency, no advisory. zod 4.5.4 -> 4.6.2 in packages/client -- a FORWARD move within zod 4, the opposite direction to PR #296's silent 4 -> 3 revert. Minor release, mostly additive (.validate(), z.instanceof().properties(), z.iban(), z.withParser(), faster CommonJS, a 4.5 recursive-schema memory-retention fix, @zod/mini as its own package) plus two patches. Three items can change validation behaviour for code that uses them: fromJSONSchema() now enforces six keywords it used to ignore; .prefault() now preserves undefined outputs and object keys (4.6.2); defaulted discriminators keep unique tags (4.6.1). This repository's client uses none of the three. Authored by hand because Dependabot cannot author a manifest (CBSP21-NOBORROW-001); the payload of that friction is the lockfile audit in behavior_change.
behavior_change: none in the shipped app. Lockfile audited against merge base 7685411c by parsing both package-lock.json trees and comparing every `packages` entry in full, not by reading the diff view. Entry count is 412 before and 412 after. Exactly 1 node_modules entry changed: zod 4.5.4 -> 4.6.2 (forward), changing only version, resolved and integrity; its own dependency map is unchanged. Zero packages added, zero removed, no other entry touched. The root entry differs in one key, dependencies.zod ^4.5.4 -> ^4.6.2. Consumer analysis: zod has exactly one importer in packages/client/src, cam/compare/compare_types.ts, and it is unreachable from src/main.ts in a full static+dynamic import-graph walk, so no shipped code path validates with zod today. Independently, a search of all client source finds zero uses of fromJSONSchema, prefault or discriminatedUnion -- the three APIs whose behaviour 4.6.x changes -- so the bump would be behaviour-neutral even if that module were mounted.

diff_articulation.what_changed: packages/client/package.json moves the single declared range for zod from ^4.5.4 to ^4.6.2 -- one line, no other dependency touched. package-lock.json resolves it: zod 4.5.4 -> 4.6.2. No incidental version movement; the added, removed and non-zod changed sets are all empty.
diff_articulation.why_not_redundant: Dependabot currency, stated plainly. No existing manifest covers this diff; the prior zod-4.5.4-bump manifest, dep-sec-pr287-zod4 and other dependency manifests would each cover these two files, and borrowing one is what CBSP21-NOBORROW-001 refuses.
